GIVE-AND-TAKE BOOKSTORE
eal Home f Store } {Contact Us} f Blog i
Posted on 02 July
Calling All Book Collectors!
Give-and-Take Bookstore is collecting used books, in any condition, for resale at
deeply discounted prices. Our £3-or-less guaranteed pricing allows us to offer
affordable reading materials. Remember, 10 percent of all proceeds from our
book sales are donated to projects in the community. This month's focus is the
restoration of Delford Park.
We currently need books in the following genres:
0 Historical Fiction o Poetry o How-to Guides
0 Science Fiction o Autobiographies o Sports
Any book donation will be rewarded with a merchandise credit (based on
20 percent of the cash value of each book) for use on a one-time purchase at
either our Delford or our Stratton location.
Book pickups are available to donors of 25 or more books. To schedule a
book pickup within a 10-kilometre radius of our stores, please e-mail us at
donations@giveandtakebooks.co.uk or call our store in Delford at 0114 496 0835.
To: | [ <cplum @homemail.co.uk> |
From: | | <donations @ giveandtakebooks.co.uk> |
Date: | [22 July
Subject: | | Re: Donation |
Hello Mr. Plum,
Thank you very much for your offer to donate 100 books to our shop! I would be happy to
arrange to have the books picked up at your home. For such a large number of books, we
are happy to go the extra distance. To expedite the pickup process, please stack the books
by genre to the best of your ability. Our driver will pack the books into boxes for you.
Our next available appointment for pickup is this Tuesday, 25 July, at 2 P.M. Let me know
if this time works for you.
Thank you,
Tina Voss, Manager
Give-and-Take Bookstore
179.

发布于 7 月 2 日
呼吁所有图书收藏家！
Give-and-Take 书店正在收集任何状况的二手书，以折扣价转售。我们保证 £3 或以下的定价使我们能够提供负担得起的阅读材料。请记住，我们图书销售所得的所有收益的 10% 将捐赠给社区项目。本月重点是德福德公园（Delford Park）的修复。
我们目前需要以下类型的书籍：
0 小说 (Historical Fiction) o 诗歌 (Poetry) o 操作指南 (How-to Guides)
0 科幻小说 (Science Fiction) o 自传 (Autobiographies) o 体育 (Sports)
任何图书捐赠都将获得商品抵用券（基于每本书现金价值的 20%），可用于在我们德福德店或斯特拉顿店进行一次性购买。
对于捐赠 25 本或更多书籍的捐赠者，提供上门取书服务。如需安排在距离我们商店 10 公里半径内的图书上门取件，请发送电子邮件至 donations@giveandtakebooks.co.uk 或致电我们德福德店：0114 496 0835。
收件人: | [ <cplum @homemail.co.uk> |
发件人: | | <donations @ giveandtakebooks.co.uk> |
日期: | [7 月 22 日
主题: | | 回复：捐赠 |
尊敬的普拉姆先生：
非常感谢您提议向我们店捐赠 100 本书！我很高兴为您安排上门取书。对于如此大量的书籍，我们很乐意付出额外的努力。为加快取件流程，请您尽力按体裁将书籍堆叠起来。我们的司机将为您把书装进箱子里。
我们下一个可用的预约时间是本周二，7 月 25 日下午 2 点。如果这个时间对您方便，请告知我。
谢谢,
蒂娜·沃斯 (Tina Voss)，经理
Give-and-Take 书店
